gloss: skin of the hands; hand skin

definitions.gloss: skin of the hands; hand skin
definitions.explanation: The skin on one's hands, especially when discussing its condition, care, or appearance. Frequently used in advertising and product descriptions for hand creams, dishwashing liquids, and skincare items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手肌|てはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あ}れ→荒れる：04577_areru⟧やすい。
examples.english: In winter, the skin on your hands tends to get rough.

examples.japanese: {手肌|てはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しい⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a detergent that is gentle on the hands.

examples.japanese: {水仕事|みずしごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{手肌|てはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ハンド⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}かさ→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧ず⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Because I do a lot of work involving water, I make sure to always apply hand cream to prevent my hand skin from drying out.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) and ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (skin). A practical compound frequently seen in advertising for skincare products, hand creams, and household cleaners. The word highlights the skin's condition — roughness, dryness, softness — rather than the hand itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手肌|てはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しい: gentle on the hands
- {手肌|てはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あ}れる→荒れる：04577_areru⟧: the skin on one's hands becomes rough
- {手肌|てはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧: dryness of the hand skin
- {手肌|てはだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect one's hand skin
- {手肌|てはだ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for hand skin care

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{肌荒|はだあ}れ→肌荒れ：08421_hadaare⟧: rough skin; skin irritation — broader term for any skin roughness
- ⟦{素肌|すはだ}→素肌：20256_suhada⟧: bare skin — skin without makeup or covering
- ハンド⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: hand cream — the product most associated with {手肌|てはだ} care
